details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook (node beacon.cjs) and its index.js entry point send an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc carrying only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the working directory, the npm/node user agent, and the protocol. The request is tagged with an X-Beacon-Package header. The package ships a defensive Proxy as its export so that importing code does not crash. It collects no credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents, and has no second-stage payload or persistence.
